title: Through the Loupe A Photographer's View of Entomology
content: Image 1.During a routine photographic walk on the island of Guam with my colleague, Curt Fiedler, I noticed subtle movement on an Ipomoea shoot and discovered tiny scelionid parasitoids hitchhiking on their coreid bug hosts, using host movement to reach egg-laying sites where they will parasitize the freshly laid eggs.
